question: What beings were born from the two fallen drops of sweat, O great goddess?
premises: From those two, beings were born.
The born beings were suited to their qualities.
inference: Two beings suited to their qualities were born from the two fallen drops of sweat.
uncertainties: The identity of the two born beings is implied by the preceding memory of Brahmā and Viṣṇu.
plain_english: O great goddess, two drops of sweat fell, and from those two were born beings suited to their qualities.
